title: camelize('', uppercase_first_letter=False) raises IndexError
property: camelize does not crash on any str; the empty string maps to the empty string for both values of uppercase_first_letter
actual: IndexError: string index out of range (string[0] at inflection/__init__.py:171)
evidence: Signature is camelize(string: str, ...) with no documented restriction on empty strings; camelize('') returns '' for the default flag, so the False branch is inconsistent.
